name: dsh-scihub
description: Sci-Hub / LibGen / Z-Library fetcher for DeepSeek Harness: scihub_pdf / scihub_batch resolve DOIs or article URLs through Sci-Hub mirrors, libgen_search / libgen_download find books by keyword and fetch the chosen file by MD5, and nine zlib_* tools provide native Z-Library EAPI search, details, download, saved books, history, quota and domain diagnostics (credentials read only from process.env). All outbound requests support HTTP/HTTPS CONNECT proxies (config.proxy or HTTPS_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY / ALL_PROXY with NO_PROXY). Files land in the session workspace with human-readable, consistent names. Batches run with bounded parallelism, dead mirrors are skipped, and truncated or challenge responses are rejected rather than saved. scihub_refresh_mirrors re-probes all candidate mirrors and writes back the live ones for self-healing after captcha or mirror death.
